text: {"lessons":["The account recovered after its declines, but short-term gains and losses do not reliably predict what comes next; I should avoid chasing trends.","Selling 30 shares of Stock C after a large gain realized some value, but I should make such decisions based on my overall risk and needs, not a gain alone.","With retirement savings to protect, I should favor deliberate, measured choices and avoid unnecessary trading or taking risks I cannot afford."]}
